headline: Record revenue, margin, and EPS as guidance jumps again
summary_short: EMCOR posted record Q2 2026 revenue of $5.15B (+19.8% y/y) and a record 10.6% operating margin, with diluted EPS of $9.06 (+34.8% y/y); the company raised full-year revenue guidance to $20.00B-$20.50B and diluted EPS guidance to $32.00-$33.25.
summary_long: Revenue grew 19.8% y/y to $5.15B (19.6% organic ex-acquisitions/UK sale), with broad-based growth led by US mechanical construction and facilities services (45% of revenue). Operating margin expanded 100bps y/y to a record 10.6% as SG&A fell to 9.2% of revenue from 9.7%. Net income rose 33.6% to $403.7M; diluted EPS $9.06 (+34.8%). Remaining performance obligations hit a record $17.14B (+43.9% y/y), led by Network and Communications, Water and Wastewater, Institutional, and Healthcare demand. Cash was $924.4M after $268.5M of YTD buybacks and $35.6M of dividends paid. EMCOR raised FY2026 guidance: revenue to $20.00B-$20.50B (from $18.50B-$19.25B), operating margin to 9.5%-9.8% (from 9.0%-9.4%), and diluted EPS to $32.00-$33.25 (from $28.25-$29.75).

drivers.explanation: Broad growth across all US segments plus incremental acquisition contribution; organic revenue (ex-acquisitions, ex-UK sale) grew 19.6% y/y.
Management cited consistent execution and discipline across segments; SG&A fell to 9.2% of revenue from 9.7% y/y.
Growth concentrated in Network and Communications, Water and Wastewater, Institutional, and Healthcare, plus new business wins across customers and geographies.
CEO Tony Guzzi attributed the quarter to "consistent execution, discipline, and customer focus" across all reportable segments.
